checks.description: S3 buckets must have all four public access block settings enabled. An aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource is required with block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, and restrict_public_buckets all set to true.
checks.impact: Partially or fully disabled public access block settings allow S3 bucket ACLs or bucket policies to expose objects to the internet, leading to data leakage or exfiltration
checks.resolution: Create an aws_s3_bucket_public_access_block resource and set block_public_acls = true, block_public_policy = true, ignore_public_acls = true, and restrict_public_buckets = true
checks.errorMessage: S3 bucket public access block is not fully configured — all four flags (block_public_acls, block_public_policy, ignore_public_acls, restrict_public_buckets) must be set to true
